title: Contract Pricing Agreement Close-Out: Substitute Price Gap Concession
content:
# Substitute price gap concession — Contract Pricing Agreement

**Rule.** On the close-out of a discontinued Contract Pricing Agreement contract item, the substitute-gap concession follows how far the substitute's unit price on its latest regular shipment (a regular shipment line of the substitute on the customer's Ship-To Fulfillment Account records, not a backorder fill) stands above the contract unit price on the discontinued item's latest price line, expressed in percent of that contract unit price.

| Substitute's price above the discontinued item's contract price | Concession |
|---|---|
| 15 percent or more | 1.0 percent off |
| At least 5 and below 15 percent | 0.5 percent off |
| Less than 5 percent above, or not above it at all | Nothing off |

An amount equal to that percent of the close-out price is taken off the close-out price before its rounding to four decimal places.

Hypothetical example: contract unit price 10.0000 and substitute shipped at 11.6000, a gap of 16 percent: 1.0 percent off.
